plainText:
Pikachu & Friends is a collection of single-disc compilation DVDs by VIZ Media (distributed by Warner Home Video) that feature eight episodes of sourced from various seasons, each focusing on a specific Pokémon.

==Volumes==
=== & Friends===
 
Released on June 1, 2021, with the ISBN number 7-82009-24726-5. Optional English-language captioning is included.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

===Pikachu & Friends - Starring ===
 
Released on September 20, 2022, with the ISBN number 7-82009-24759-3. Optional English-language captioning is included.
